program.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
requirements.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

nodes.question: Does the image show chalk-like medium or surface treatment, and how broadly is that treatment applied across the main depicted content?
nodes.criteria: pass: visible chalk-like marks or texture are applied broadly across the main depicted content; fail: no visible chalk-like treatment is evident; unknown: the medium or its coverage cannot be determined. If treatment is visible but uneven or localized, pass only as evidence of chalk-like progress and describe the uneven coverage; do not imply full-image conversion.
nodes.binding: Assess only visible chalk-like medium or treatment and its coverage. Preserve mixed evidence; do not assess drawing form or infer completion.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly present its depicted content as a drawing rather than an unchanged photograph, and how broadly is that drawing treatment applied?
nodes.criteria: pass: visible drawing treatment is present across depicted content; fail: no visible drawing treatment is evident; unknown: drawing appearance or its coverage cannot be determined. If treatment is mixed, with some areas drawn and substantial areas retaining photographic appearance, pass only as evidence of drawing progress and describe the unevenness; do not imply the whole image is converted.
nodes.binding: Assess only drawing appearance and its coverage, not chalk medium. Preserve mixed evidence and do not infer whole-image conversion from isolated contours.

nodes.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
nodes.criteria: Use only saved statuses and image-grounded evidence from n1 and n2. complete: both supports pass and their evidence establishes chalk-like treatment and drawing form broadly across the image, with no substantial unconverted areas indicated. partial: at least one support provides positive evidence of requested chalk/drawing progress, but the evidence indicates uneven or incomplete application, or does not establish full-image conversion. absent: both supports fail and their evidence establishes no requested chalk-like or drawing progress. unknown: no support provides positive evidence and at least one is unknown, or the evidence is insufficient to determine whether any requested progress occurred. A support failure alone is not proof of absence; do not infer facts beyond the saved evidence. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
nodes.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk. Combine the independent evidence for chalk medium and drawing form; do not inspect images or add requirements.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.

response.content: {"accepted":false,"reason":"The support checks do not establish the requested extent reliably. n1 treats broad coverage of the main depicted content as evidence of progress but does not determine whether the whole image has been converted; n2 likewise allows a pass for drawing treatment across depicted content without defining or checking substantial unconverted areas consistently. The readout then permits complete when both supports pass and their evidence establishes broad treatment, so it can infer full-image conversion from coarse coverage. This fails the requirement that a coarse support pass not imply an unexamined finer condition."}

parsed.reason: The support checks do not establish the requested extent reliably. n1 treats broad coverage of the main depicted content as evidence of progress but does not determine whether the whole image has been converted; n2 likewise allows a pass for drawing treatment across depicted content without defining or checking substantial unconverted areas consistently. The readout then permits complete when both supports pass and their evidence establishes broad treatment, so it can infer full-image conversion from coarse coverage. This fails the requirement that a coarse support pass not imply an unexamined finer condition.
